claims.statement: Reconstruction of inherited exact ATT-v3 and RS1 scope; no new review or attack.
Exact same-T and redrawn-T Fourier formulas; no joint single-character improvement; bounded Fourier-l1 scope only.
Strict determinant norm gates force small-output public multiplier witnesses to cancel the hidden ideal part, and force nonzero short multipliers to have CRT support greater than n/2.
Every half-root orbit union of every index<=r subgroup contains more than d/4 support points except probability at most N_G 2^r (2/3^(3/4))^d.
Source witness probability bounded by eta_rel plus the full coefficient Gaussian tail.
dependencies: SC-v1 full independent uniform amplitude law

claims.statement: At both frozen baseline d families, r=o(d), C=n,b=ell^2,B=2n^2ell^2 satisfy all gates eventually and give negligible acceptance at both source and uniform endpoints.
For degree<k polynomial multiplier pairs, exact hidden cancellation probability <=min(1,k q^(2k-d)/(q-1)) for every fixed T.

superseded_versions.reason: Tail formula undefined at permitted b=0; asymptotic specialization unaffected.

required_reviews: fresh recheck of v2 boundary repair
scientific_limit: No improved general distinguisher, Base2 hardness theorem, elimination of a baseline source regime, or general lattice lower bound has been established. The obstruction is for the explicitly frozen short fixed-field joint-relation witness class.
